turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good morning. How long have you had the shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: About two weeks, and I feel dizzy when I stand up.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are you still taking metformin five hundred milligrams twice daily?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, and lisinopril ten milligrams once daily.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your hemoglobin A1c was seven point two percent. I will increase the atorvastatin to forty milligrams.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Should I be worried about the chest pain?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Any chest pain with exertion needs an electrocardiogram today.
